title: Dash variables
description: Configuration variables for Dash across POSIX, Windows native (MSVC), and MS-DOS.

DASH_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install Dash. 'libscript_native' installs isolated prebuilt binaries (SamuelMarks/dash-windows on Windows/MS-DOS), 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

DASH_VERSION.description: Specific version of dash to install (e.g., 0.5.12 or latest).

DASH_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading dash binary or archive artifacts.

DASH_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying dash available remote releases.
